notes.title: Want to playtest Far Far West?
notes.content:
[p]Howdy everyone!

We're pleased to announce the reveal of our new game [b]Far Far West[/b]! To celebrate, we'd like to invite you to join us through its development! We’re opening [b]sign-ups for future playtests[/b], so if blasting monsters, casting spells, and causing chaos with your chums sounds like something you’d enjoy, hit the link below! Your feedback is going to be incredibly helpful to us, so a big thank you in advance. :) 

👉 [b][u][url="https://bit.ly/FarFarWestPlaytest"]Sign up here to join the playtest[/url]

[/u][/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/f987c3cd34011004307c0d5b22074b5b042d7c9e.gif"][/img][h2][b]So, what is [i]Far Far West[/i]?[/b] [/h2] [/p][p]We can sum it up in two words: Robot Cowboys. Or, for a slightly longer description: Get ready for mayhem in our 4-player co-op shooter! Grab your pals and play as badass gunslingin’ robot cowboys, hunting bounties and taking on crazy contacts. Explore spooky and strange environments and fight off hordes of enemies - from reanimated skeletons to MASSIVE boss monsters.  [/p][p][b]Shape your loadout to match your style![/b] Choose your guns, upgrade them, and spice up your gameplay with powerful spells. Whether you prefer big damage, clever support skills, or just want to look good doing it, there’s a playstyle for everyone. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45651795/8ce335d64e205e9b6087bcf1d579ce9da7bd7eac.gif"][/img]
Before we go, we wouldn’t be true indie devs without asking (pleading with) you to wishlist. If you can, adding us to your WL really helps us smaller teams get noticed, which would give us an amazing head start towards launch. Thank you for your support, it means a lot! 
  
Far Far West is our dream project, and this is just the beginning. We can’t wait to show you more very soon; there’s so many elements of our game that we’re buzzing to talk about. [/p][p]In the meantime, don’t forget to [url="https://discord.gg/bE5PRAHRY2"][u][b]Join our Discord[/b][/u][/url] and [url="https://bit.ly/FarFarWestPlaytest"][u][b]sign up for playtesting[/b][/u][/url], we’d love to have you along for the ride! [/p][p]More soon,  [/p][p]Evil Raptor Team   [/p]
